reference.job: Harbor Oracle (archived reference run; final job id recorded in authoring/BUILD-AUDIT-2026-10-26.md)

valid_non_migrating.patch: non-empty documentation-only patch: applies cleanly, changes no behaviour

test_phase.note: hard gate PASS; verifier failed on F2P, so T is computed and is 0

empty_patch_input_rejected.patch: empty patch: rejected as input, never reaches the test phase

partial_migration.patch: setup.cfg only: click>=6.7,!=7.0 -> click==8.1.7; no other migration change

source_qualification.code_state: unpatched base at the fixed commit, Click 6.7

no_op_distinction: The empty patch is an input check: grader.py rejects it before the patch is applied, so no test runs and the 0 reward says nothing about whether the verifier detects an incomplete migration. The documentation-only patch is the migration no-op: it applies cleanly, the build and native tests run, the migration suite starts, and the run scores 0 because all 11 F2P nodes report the pre-migration behaviour. The two results are reported separately and are not interchangeable.

node_count_history.explanation: An earlier acceptance record said the empty-patch run had '47 required nodes all failed'. The raw artifact of that run records 55 tests, so the sentence was a documentation error; it is not corrected by rewriting 47 as another number. The 47 figure matches the observation total of the node set before the P2P-005/014/033 retirement (38 P2P + 9 F2P); the raw record of that run shows 55 because the replacement nodes had already been added (46 P2P + 9 F2P). The split changed again in this round: F2P-002/005/006 asserted facts that already hold on the unpatched base, so they became P2P-054/055/056, and the current set is 60 observations (49 P2P + 11 F2P).

earlier_empty_patch_run.note: historical Windows temporary path; not present in this workspace, values retained as documented history only

node_count_history.retirement: P2P-053 was retired in the P2P calibration round because the concurrent-reader interleaving was not reliably observable across implementations; the corresponding instruction sentence was removed. The historical raw records below still describe the 49-P2P set.

scope_note: Rewards were measured against the archived build's verifier. Coverage limits are recorded in coverage-audit.json under separate headings and are not interchangeable: (1) a node that ran and passed; (2) a platform that was never executed -- the Linux verifier does not run Windows launchers, which is not an observation about Windows; (3) a sub-requirement a passing node deliberately does not assert. The reference row is the real Harbor Oracle run; no-op/partial/empty are direct-container controls from the archived tests tree. The current tree has retired P2P-053 and has not yet been recalibrated.

revision.what_changed: Replaced missing historical references with artifacts produced by this build; re-ran reference, no-op, partial and empty controls against the current verifier. The no-op result now correctly shows hard gate PASS + verifier failed + T=0 after the hard-gate triage fix.

post_change_note: P2P-053 was retired and the concurrent-reader sentence was removed from instruction.md. The certified_version and runs below are the archived 49-P2P/60-observation calibration; they are retained as historical evidence and do not certify the current 48-P2P/59-observation tree. A fresh Oracle, source qualification, no-op/partial controls, and model trials are required before this task is certified again.
